verdict.rationale: Cooley GO Docs offers first-party document generators, not just static forms. They produce real legal packages: Delaware incorporation (charter, bylaws, RSPA with IP assignment), several YC Safe versions, and Series Seed financing documents. Conditional logic, such as automatically adding 83(b) and escrow documents when stock vests, shows true assembly, and a community post separately confirms the generators exist alongside templates. Missing for 10: a documented description of the online questionnaire/interview flow and the output formats, and hands-on independent corroboration of the completion experience.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
